text: This letter is to inform you that City Council, at its meeting on Monday April 23 and 24, 2025, considered DM29.1 entitled “Appointment of a Public Member to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal” and appointed Sophia Davis to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal for a term of office beginning March 28, 2025 and ending on November 14, 2026.
The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Received the (April 29, 2025) letter from the City Clerk.
